posts.text: 🇷🇺 Russia ready to continue talks with the US and Ukraine, warns Europe against ultimatums Deputy Foreign Minister Sergey Ryabkov stated that Moscow is prepared to resume trilateral negotiations in the format of the meetings held on 10-11 November in Abu Dhabi. The dates for the next round have not yet been determined. During the talks, the American and Ukrainian sides were presented with detailed frameworks for a future conflict settlement. Ryabkov noted he was unaware of any contacts with representatives of European states regarding their participation. He warned that if the European "troika" begins setting preconditions for a visit to Moscow, it will effectively deprive itself of the possibility to dialogue with the Russian side. Additionally, Ryabkov announced new Russian-American contacts on issues causing disagreements in bilateral relations. @Slavyangrad
